faqs.q: Where can I find general grants and funding information?
faqs.a: You can use the Grants and funding finder for NSW Government or the Grants and programs finder for business.gov.au.

faqs.q: What financial assistance is available for small businesses after a disaster?
faqs.a: The NSW Rural Assistance Authority offers low-interest recovery loans for small businesses impacted by natural disasters, and there is a Disaster Assistance Finder.

faqs.q: What rebates are available for small businesses?
faqs.a: You can apply for the SafeWork small business rebate (up to $1,000) or the National Energy Bill Relief payment (up to $150).

faqs.q: How can I get tailored support for my business?
faqs.a: Book a call with the Service NSW Business Bureau for one-on-one, tailored support.
